My playbook for growing a $1M AI agency: https://app.aiautomationsociety.ai/opaa-ads-optin
My FREE resources: https://www.skool.com/ai-automation-society/about?el=grok-bot&hcategory=youtube-videos&utm_campaign=free-group

My Tools💻
FREE MONTH voice to text: https://get.glaido.com/nate
Code NATEHERK for 10% off VPS (annual plan): https://www.hostinger.com/vps/claude-code-hosting

Grok Bot makes it surprisingly easy to spin up a team of specialized AI agents that stay synced across your computer and phone. 

In this video, I walk through agent computers, teachable skills, scheduled routines, Slack triggers, agents messaging each other, and a live multi-agent website build. I also break down where GrokBot fits next to Claude Code, Codex, and Hermes, plus the limitations you should know before building your whole workflow around it.

comments.text:
You're creating solutions for AI current redundancies which will be streamlined as time passes nullifying the entire system and making your own even more redundant. This would be fine for trying to run a one man business band for now, but updates will naturally break it. Agents and bots will eventually be built in, executed, and logic applied based on complexity of the task based on the users request. 

To simplify this: it's like having a hard drive, processor, graphics card, ram, power supply, motherboard, and case be individual bots/agents talking to each other without actually being built in together with each other. AI will evolve to be a computer. There won't be a need for agents/bots

Sad thing is I don't think the LLM matters much, of course every LLM is different but you know what I mean. There is no way that the grok bot capability, without the LLM, would cost 200/month. So basically the grok LLM is 180/month. It kind of makes sense because these bots will be using a lot of tokens per month,  so it's not reasonable to expect less than 100/month if you are a daily user. But for light use, that's not justifiable, so it should be credit based. As it is, the light users are funding the heavy users.

Secondly why should I have to use a particular LLM with grok bot? It's vendor locking. The AI providers should probably get a cut, but i shouldn't be locked in to one UI + harness + LLM.
